subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider land allowlisted GHE data-residency routing with device-enterprise auth, COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN/githubDomain selection, and domain-scoped Copilot token caching?
rationale: The implementation looks coherent, but it changes provider setup and the security boundary for where GitHub OAuth and Copilot API tokens are sent, which automation should not approve on maintainer intent alone.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Approve this provider-owned host-routing contract and land after exact-head checks and normal owner/security review stay green.

options.title: Request targeted hardening first
options.body: Ask for a narrow follow-up change if maintainers want stricter hostname validation, different env/config precedence, or a smaller SDK export surface before merge.

options.title: Reject or re-scope to plugin work
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide GHE data-residency Copilot routing should not live in the bundled provider.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Approve this provider-owned host-routing contract and land after exact-head checks and normal owner/security review stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combination of recent current-main history on the touched auth/provider files and listed Security ownership in CONTRIBUTING.md.
